verdicts.reason: A is cramped: the oversized headline nearly touches the top edge and its 'z' runs into the two decorative circles, which are now jammed together in the top-right corner. The bottle touches the top and bottom edges, the body copy wraps awkwardly across three lines, and the button sits squeezed against the right edge. B has a cleaner left-to-right reading order with the circles kept apart, but it is still flawed: the single-line body copy is very small at this size, the bottle nearly touches the top and bottom edges, the button partly overlaps the green circle, and the logo is cut off from everything else.
